remarks: Set on a beautifully landscaped, level lot in the sought-after Springdale neighborhood, this warm and inviting home offers space, style, and functionality. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, complementing a bright living room and a formal dining area with sliding doors that open to a spacious deck and fully fenced backyard-ideal for outdoor entertaining. The kitchen shines with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space. A full bath with a walk-in shower completes the main level. Upstairs, three large bedrooms offer abundance of closet space and natural light, while a full bath with tile flooring and a tub/shower combo adds convenience. The expansive lower-level family room provides the perfect spot to relax, play, or work from home. Move-in ready and close to shops, dining, and transportation, this home blends comfort and convenience in a truly welcoming setting.
